question: What are 12-month SKU-level sales of plant milks (soy, nut, oat), chay foods, plant-based meat and plant protein powder on Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada, 2025 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Would show whether any analogue or high-protein SKU has sustained online sales (ch23, TPP-02, TPP-05); marketplace pages cannot be read with desk tools and free Metric posts give no plant or chay split
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy one Metric.vn category report, or use its 7-day trial, for the keywords sua hat, sua dau nanh, sua yen mach, do chay, thit chay, protein thuc vat

question: Does a numeric protein claim lift sales against the same product without it?
why_it_matters: ch23 reads rising searches and one Vinamilk launch as a sign that protein now sells; TPP-02 and TPP-05 rest on it; the only protein-claimed soy milk in the kitchen channel sells less than unclaimed ones
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask Vinamilk for Sua Hat Cao Dam against 9 loai hat sales; ask Kamereo for GoldSoy Giau Dam monthly sales; or run a paired Shopee listing test with one chay maker
owner_org_to_ask: Vinamilk; Kamereo; a chay maker (An Nhien or Au Lac)

question: When did Kamereo start each sales counter, and what were last-12-month sales by SKU for plant milks, tofu, sausages and meats?
why_it_matters: Turns cumulative counters into rates, so shares of kitchen demand can be stated with confidence
cheapest_way_to_close: Email Kamereo with a short data request; offer the aggregated result back

question: Who makes GoldSoy and SuperSoy soy milks, and how much protein do they carry per 100 ml?
why_it_matters: A second maker selling a protein-claimed plant milk is a possible T10 buyer; its label value is needed for price per gram of protein
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the pack in a store, or ask Kamereo for the supplier

question: How much barista plant milk do Vietnamese cafe chains buy, and would they take a local rice, mung bean or soy barista base?
why_it_matters: Oat barista milk made in Thailand is the plant-milk SKU with the highest sell-through in the kitchen channel; it is a use where a T10 isolate or a local base could replace imports
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the Oatside Vietnam distributor and two cafe chains for annual volumes, prices and specifications
owner_org_to_ask: Oatside Vietnam distributor; Highlands Coffee; The Coffee House
